decisions.reason: Despite being only briefly mentioned, the firm has invested in and publicly committed to this mechanical weir, and escalation of commitment makes a near-term drop unlikely.

Although the energy management system is less central to the firm's machinery core, the firm has publicly mentioned it and can attribute weak early results to temporary adoption delays, so escalation favors keeping it.
The firm has given this overflow flap gate its own web page, signaling strong public commitment and sunk investment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
